Registered as Bioniq (Pty) Ltd (2015/338013/07), it utilizes a hybrid network of fibre-optic backbones and high-capacity wireless microwave infrastructure to serve remote mining and agricultural areas that national ISPs often overlook [cite: 9, 18, 24].

- Trading Relationship: Acts as the primary ISP for Veralogix mine sites, ensuring the uptime of real-time freight telemetry and condition monitoring systems [cite: 16].
- Revenue Flow Model: Recurring subscription revenue from domestic and corporate clients, scaling up to 1 Gbps symmetrical links [cite: 1, 18].
- Shared Services: Leverages Veramani's AI fabric to optimize bandwidth management and network monitoring across remote sites [cite: 25].

## 3. Vcom: The Infrastructure Layer and Township Connectivity

Vcom (Pty) Ltd (2024/916862/07) specializes in the design, deployment, and maintenance of aerial fibre networks [cite: 15]. Positioned within the VEA Group's investment portfolio, Vcom bridges the digital divide by bringing high-speed connectivity to underserved township communities and low LSM areas [cite: 15, 26].

- Trading Relationship: Collaborates with Bioniq to provide bundled ISP and hotspot solutions, creating a ubiquitous internet experience for end-users [cite: 25].
- Revenue Flow Model: Project-based revenue from large-scale fibre builds, micro-trenching, and SLA-backed maintenance for municipalities [cite: 15, 26].
- Shared Services: Integrates its network lifecycle management with Veramani's IT infrastructure to streamline internal operations and reduce OPEX [cite: 25].

## 4. YAL.ai: The Security and AI Fraud Protection Layer

YAL.ai provides a specialized AI-powered communication application designed to detect and block phishing SMS and voice fraud in real-time [cite: 1]. Summary of Subsidiary Synergy and Revenue Flow

| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Veramani IT | AI & Data Orchestration | All 16 Veralogix Entities | Centralized intelligence and signal routing [cite: 16]. |
| Bioniq | Fibre & Wireless ISP | Veralogix Mining & Plant | Uptime for real-time fleet telemetry [cite: 16]. |
| Vcom | Aerial Fibre Build | Municipalities/Bioniq | Infrastructure for bundled retail ISP packages [cite: 25]. |
| YAL.ai | AI Anti-Phishing | External Corporate Clients | High-margin security SaaS for industrial portals [cite: 1].
